ov: حرب العوالم (الإنجليزية: War of the Worlds)، هو فيلم خيال علمي كارثي من إنتاج عام 2005 ومن إخراج ستيفن سبيلبرغ، وهي مأخوذة عن رواية بنفس الاسم للكاتب هـ. ج. ويلز. تم تصوير الفيلم في 73 يوما حيث تم التصوير في مواقع مثل كونيتيكت، جزيرة ستاتن، كاليفورنيا، فيرجينيا ونيو جيرسي. الفيلم تلقى مراجعات إيجابية عموما وكان فيلما ناجحا أيضا في شباك التذاكر حيث احتل المركز الرابع على قائمة الأفلام الأكثر نجاحا على الصعيد المحلي مع 234 مليون دولار في أمريكا الشمالية و 591 مليون دولار على مستوى العالم.
plotEn:
Charming but self-absorbed longshoreman Ray Ferrier, working as a crane operator in Brooklyn, New York, has his estranged children—teenage son Robbie and ten-year-old daughter Rachel—dropped off with him by his pregnant ex-wife Mary Ann while she visits her parents in Boston. After which, a thunderstorm strikes a nearby intersection multiple times, causing an electromagnetic pulse that immediately disables all electronic devices. Ray investigates the site of the impacts, where an earthquake begins, and witnesses a massive "tripod" war machine emerging from the ground, which uses energy weapons to begin disintegrating the witnesses.

Ray gathers supplies and loads Rachel and Robbie into the only working vehicle and attempts to persuade his friend Manny to come with them, but is forced to leave due to a tripod attack. Ray drives his children to Mary Ann's empty suburban New Jersey home to take refuge, where a Boeing 747 crashes into the neighborhood. Ray meets a wandering television news team scavenging the wreckage, upon which a correspondent reveals that many tripods have attacked major cities around the world and that they are protected by force shields. She adds that the tripods' pilots seemingly traveled to Earth within the lightning storms to enter their machines, presumed to have been buried underground long ago.
